name: Jess
source:
When Jess plays on stage his energy captivate audiences, creating deep connections through performance.

He doubts his worth beyond his music, masking self-doubt with confidence.

Jess channels his struggles with insecurity into his music, performing in cafés and bands while wrestling with questions about his identity outside his art.
